prompt: how to change a flat tire

plan.title: How to Change a Flat Tire Safely
plan.description: A quick, practical guide to changing a flat tire, from stopping safely to tightening the lug nuts. Learn the order that keeps you safe and gets you back on the road.

beats.narration: A flat tire feels like a disaster, but it is a job you can do in minutes. First, pull over on firm, flat ground, away from traffic. Turn on your hazard lights and set the parking brake.

props.alt: vehicle with hazard lights on roadside

beats.narration: Take out the spare, the jack and the wrench. Loosen the lug nuts a little while the wheel is still on the ground. Then place the jack at the right point and lift the car.
Now remove the nuts and pull the flat tire off. Slide the spare onto the bolts. Hand-tighten the nuts, then lower the car until the tire touches the ground.

props.alt: hands replacing a wheel on a car

beats.narration: Lower the car fully, then tighten the nuts firmly in a star pattern. Put your tools and the flat tire away. Check the spare's pressure soon, and get the flat repaired.

props.heading: Before you drive off
items: Tighten nuts in a star pattern
Stow the tools and flat tire

beats.narration: That is the whole job: stop safely, loosen, lift, swap, tighten. Do it in that order, and a flat tire becomes a small delay instead of a crisis.

props.text: Stop safely, loosen, lift, swap, tighten.
